entities.name: Karrak
entities.description: A battle-weary Suwwardi soldier in Mishra's Fallaji army, member of the Third Tomakul Spears.

entities.name: Farid
entities.description: Karrak's friend in the Third Tomakul Spears.

entities.name: Aiman
entities.description: Soldier who discussed deserting with Karrak and Farid.

entities.name: Ehsan
entities.description: Soldier who joined Karrak's covert mission.

entities.name: Argivians

events.summary: In the trenches near Tomakul in 44 AR, Karrak, Farid and Aiman discuss deserting before an offensive after new orders signal an attack.
events.quote: Karrak, Farid, and Aiman discussed deserting before the offensive

events.summary: Karrak joins Farid, Aiman and Ehsan on a covert mission through the trenches; Farid negotiates with Sergeant Usman and a trade with the Argivians takes place.
events.quote: Karrak joined Farid, Aiman, and Ehsan in a covert mission through the trenches

events.summary: The group crosses the battlefield and reaches the abandoned Argivian trench.
events.quote: Upon reaching the abandoned Argivian trench
